items.title: Live: Israel would not strike without Trump go-ahead, Iran says after US plea for calm
items.description: Israel says it has struck military targets in western and central Iran after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a series of strikes on northern Israel. Follow live.

items.title: A 'ring of fire' could soon burn around one of Australia's major cities
items.description: Australian states are pushing ahead with waste-to-energy incineration despite significant opposition. It means one capital city will soon be surrounded by a "ring of fire".

items.title: As One Nation nips at his heels the PM has no choice but to play the long game
items.description: The government is playing a long game in responding to the surge of support for One Nation. It has little other choice.

items.title: Script reveals methods of Cambodian centre scamming Australians
items.description: Australian and Thai police release a script discovered in a Cambodian scam compound, revealing the high-pressure methods used to coerce Australian victims.

items.title: Deaths, damage and tsunami after magnitude-7.8 earthquake hits Philippines
items.description: A powerful magnitude-7.8 earthquake has shaken the Mindanao region in the southern Philippines, with a tsunami possible on some regional coasts.

items.title: PM pays tribute to 'personal friend' and former neighbour Richard Scolyer
items.description: Loved ones of former Australian of the Year Richard Scolyer have paid tribute to his legacy, with his family saying he "wanted cancer patients to know they weren't alone".

items.title: Live: Mihocek experienced 'lack of feeling' before hospital visit says coach
items.description: Melbourne claims an eight-point win over Collingwood at the MCG as Brody Mihocek is taken to hospital after a serious injury. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Moses expected to be named for Origin II
items.description: Parramatta five-eighth Mitchell Moses might have missed the King's Birthday match against Canterbury but he's set to be named to play for New South Wales in Origin II. Follow live.

items.title: Undersea volcano inundates island with 'desert' of stone
items.description: Residents are concerned about access to food and fresh water as pumice stone makes travel difficult for Papua New Guinea's seafaring communities.

items.title: Sentencing of officer Benedict Bryant a rare moment of accountability
items.description: Inside a quiet district courtroom in the heart of Sydney’s bustling CBD, a historic moment has unfolded involving a NSW Police sergeant.

items.title: Australian dollar dives to two-month low as interest rate fears grip markets
items.description: The Australian dollar falls to its lowest level in over two months, just over 70 cents to the US dollar, amid a renewed surge in the greenback as global interest rates, including US interest rates, rise.

items.title: Top neurologists say regulator ignored warnings as weed killer decision looms
items.description: Australia's leading movement disorder specialists say the chemical regulator has not engaged with their concerns about paraquat, despite growing evidence linking the herbicide to Parkinson's disease.

items.title: Celebrities slip and slide in first Big Freeze event since Neale Daniher's death
items.description: The MCG has hosted the first Big Freeze MND fundraiser since the death of AFL legend and motor neurone disease campaigner, Neale Daniher.

items.title: Rider killed in Finke Desert Race crash identified as Matthew Bielefeld
items.description: A motorcyclist who died while competing in this weekend's Finke Desert Race outside Alice Springs has been identified as Matthew Bielefeld.

items.title: Lentils can cost just a few dollars. Here are five tasty ways to use them
items.description: From soups to bolognese and oven bakes, lentils are a versatile and affordable meal option.

items.title: Secrets of Indigenous astronomy revealed in new exhibition
items.description: Newcastle Art Gallery presents the distinctive and intricate work of the Torres Strait Islander artist in its first major solo survey following a four-year refurbishment.

items.title: With his pet chihuahua and trusty gopher, 97yo grazier won't slow down
items.description: At 97, Doug Harrison still scoots around his outback station, doing as much work as he can. As he nears a century of living, he reflects on memorable moments over the decades, with a cuppa in hand and his trusty chihuahua by his side.

items.title: The electric classic car that now drives like a 'pocket rocket'
items.description: It may look like a small vintage car, but an EV conversion has brought it "up to speed" to its modern counterparts.

items.title: Tasmania's population boom has gone bust and it spells trouble
items.description: From being a hot destination 10 years ago, Tasmania's population growth has ground to a halt. Big changes will be needed to reverse the trend, experts say.

items.title: Indigenous families want 'crisis' investigated after 15 deaths in six months
items.description: Remote Indigenous communities across Australia are painfully aware that their life expectancy rates are worsening — and in one Northern Territory community, residents are calling for an investigation into a local death rate they feel is "not normal".

items.title: When a detective told a witness Joanna was pregnant, she took police to VCAT
items.description: A woman who says she suffered life-changing stress and anxiety — and later, the death of one of her babies — after a Victoria Police officer unlawfully disclosed that she was pregnant wants her story known.

items.title: Anthropic has its eyes on Australia — and a large slice of its electricity output
items.description: The world's biggest tech titans see Australia as a promising investment opportunity for their AI ambitions, but some fear the federal government's regulatory retreat could lead to harm.

items.title: The 20-year-old Australian named one of the hottest players ahead of the FIFA World Cup
items.description: Nestory Irankunda is set for a breakout moment at the FIFA World Cup as the face of a changing Socceroos team featuring six players of African descent.

items.title: Kings and Queens of the Desert crowned as outback Finke race wraps up
items.description: Returning legends of the Finke Desert Race, David Walsh and Travis Robinson, have been crowned Kings of the Desert at the gruelling two-day off-road race, with Walsh winning on bikes for a record-equalling sixth time and Robinson claiming victory on cars.

items.title: Korda wins US Women's Open title with perilous final putt
items.description: Nelly Korda claims the US Women's Open for her second consecutive major victory, holding off Charley Hull and Gaby Lopez by one shot in Los Angeles.
